name: RideNow
tagline: Ride-hailing for one city: rider app, driver app, ops console, live dispatch, wallets and payouts.
description:
A complete ride-hailing product for Bengaluru, built as three apps on one TypeScript API and one PostgreSQL database.

Riders book with upfront fares, surge and promo codes, watch the car arrive on a live map, start the ride with a PIN, pay by wallet or cash and rate the driver. Drivers go online, receive timed offers, run the trip, and track earnings, payouts, ratings and documents. The operations team runs the city: a live map of drivers and trips, trip investigation with the full dispatch and money trail, refunds, rider and driver accounts, document review and approval, pricing per vehicle type, surge zones, promo codes, driver payouts, a finance view of the platform ledger, a support desk and an audit log of every operator action.

Everything runs without credentials: payments, SMS and maps are mocks behind interfaces, and simulated demo drivers accept and complete rides on their own, so one person can see the whole flow. Sign in with the demo logins below, or make it yours by chat.
